resources.string: Enter your normal password here, not your TOTP code. Only enter the code when it is explicitly requested.
The sign-in service did not approve the sign-in. Please sign in again.
The sign-in service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
The sign-in service requires a new sign-in or another confirmation step. Please sign in again.
The sign-in service could not complete the sign-in. Please try again.
Web sign-ins are saved more reliably to keep Zimbra, Talk and IT Help available after an app restart.
A hint explains when to enter your normal password instead of TOTP. Sign-in service errors are no longer all shown as a cancellation.
